title: MV Pokemon TCG-like card game plugin

posts.author: ThatIndieSphinx
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I searched through some of the plugins that other people have made, namely
Card Game Combat
and
Triple Triad
, as well as some other ones. However, I could not find one that sort of replicates the Pokémon TCG style, where the deck is made up of characters as a card, instead of actions such as attack or heal. Triple Triad was close, but still isn't what I was looking for, as it is different from the standard turn-based card combat. The best one I found was the
Card Game by Irina
, which included everything I wanted, but the ith.io page had been taken down, leaving me unable to download it. Are there any similar plugins that also fit this criteria?
